core_obligations: Neighbourhood (proof lines 1420-1423): take a quasi-compact open U around e, replace by U cap i(U) so U is inversion-stable; separatedness keeps it quasi-compact.
Construction (proof lines 1423-1429): set G' = union of m_n(U x ... x U) over n >= 1, where m_n is the n-slot multiplication map.
Open and closed (proof lines 1430-1434): each m_n is open (cited lemma), so G' is an open subgroup scheme; the second cited lemma makes it closed.
proof_roadmap: Choose the inversion-stable quasi-compact neighbourhood (proof lines 1420-1423).
Form G' as the union of the multiplication images (proof lines 1423-1429).
Conclude open and closed via the two cited lemmas (proof lines 1430-1434).
